description:
List posts/comments where your connected account is mentioned, tagged, or quoted.

Supported platforms: instagram (tags + mentions), threads, bluesky (mentions + quotes). (Not available on facebook, youtube, or linkedin.)

For bluesky, each item's platformData.replyRefs lets you reply_to_comment directly.

accountId.description: Specific connected account id. Omit to use the first connected account for the platform.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

platform.description: Mentions platform: instagram, threads, or bluesky.

name: list_mentions
title: List Mentions
